text:
Priya S: heads up 1: we noticed the per-model cost dashboard shows weird negative "savings" spikes for some tenants during rolling pool upgrades.
Omar V: repro'd this morning. looks like cache credits are assigned to pool_id at the time of eviction, not to the eventual consumer. sticky routing + pool bounce = credit lands in the wrong bucket.
Priya S: want to propose two alternative attribution models before we ship: token-tagging vs fingerprint-aggregate.
Alex R: quick defs?
Priya S: token-tagging = when a response is served from cache we emit a lightweight tag with route_id, session_id, & model_sku into invocation events. later, when computing tenant cost we rehydrate tags and subtract attributed saved tokens. high-accuracy but requires extra event volume.
Jen L: fingerprint-aggregate = aggregate cache_events by prefix-fingerprint and time-window, then split credits by observed session shares. lower event overhead but less precise for cross-pool session-migration.
Sam T: rough cost tradeoff?
Priya S: token-tagging: +accurate, +easy to explain, -higher telemetry bill (rough calc: +12% event volume), -needs provenance on edge code. fingerprint: +cheap, +works with current events, -can misattribute when affinity changes.
Omar V: performance concern: tagging requires adding ~2 fields to every invocation event. downstream consumers (bigquery/warehouse) will blow up if we don't sample or compress.
Alex R: sample sketch: implement tagging opt-in per-tenant. default = fingerprint-aggregate; tenants with SLA-sensitive billing can request "exact attribution" and enable tagging for their routes.
Jen L: UX ask: console should show attribution mode per-tenant and an "estimated accuracy" score. Also show a small diff preview between pool-only and attributed views.
Priya S: SQL sketch for fingerprint approach:
```sql
-- pool-level credits aggregated by fingerprint and minute
with pool_min as (
  select fingerprint, date_trunc('minute', ts) as m, sum(credits) as credits
  from cache_events
  where ts between $__start and $__end
  group by fingerprint, m
), session_min as (
  select tenant_id, fingerprint, date_trunc('minute', ts) as m, sum(session_toks) as toks
  from invocations
  where ts between $__start and $__end
  group by tenant_id, fingerprint, m
)
select s.tenant_id, p.m, p.fingerprint,
       p.credits * (s.toks / nullif(sum(s.toks) over (partition by p.fingerprint, p.m),0)) as tenant_credit
from pool_min p
join session_min s on s.fingerprint = p.fingerprint and s.m = p.m;
```
Priya S: tagging flow would be simpler to reconcile but needs an ingest toggle.
Sam T: telemetry hook: emit cost.attribution.{mode} with fields: mode, sample_rate, tenant_id, window_seconds. That will help us monitor drift.
Omar V: operational edge: if we roll this change mid-billing-cycle, customers will see discrepancies between preview and invoice. Billing team needs to sign off and we need a migration plan.
BillingBot: FYI: any attribution change requires 30d notice and reconciliation run. Flagging @billing.
Jen L: noted. We'll add an "opt-in preview" flag in console so tenants can opt in to see attributed numbers without affecting invoice. tooltip will state "preview only" and show attribution mode + sample rate.
Alex R: implementation plan: (1) add API flag attribution_mode on GET /costs (options: pool_only, fingerprint_split, token_tagging_optin) (2) add console toggle for tenant admins (3) server emits telemetry event for every run (4) materialize per-minute aggregates for fingerprint mode to keep cost low.
Sam T: agree. for matviews let's shard by fingerprint hash % 256 to keep reparallelizable.
Priya S: who owns the matview infra? Omar?
Omar V: I'll prototype a 1-minute matview with downsampled session weights and a 5% sample path for tagging rollouts. will post perf numbers by EOD tomorrow.
Jen L: docs: I'll draft copy for console and billing note. include examples of negative-savings cases and how to interpret confidence.
Alex R: ok. Action items: Omar prototype matview + perf; Sam add API param + server telemetry; Jen draft UX + preview toggle; Priya coordinate billing notice.
Priya S: thanks folks. small ask 1: can we also include a small dashboard panel that shows "attribution delta" (pool_only vs chosen mode) over last 7 days so customers can eyeball impact?
Sam T: yup will add a delta sparkline to the cost card.
CostBot: automated check passed 1: attribution_mode enum added to API schema PR in staging. remember to file billing ticket.
Alex R: great, closing thread.
